summary: Iteration 2 targeted verification of 5 fixes on top of the already-working baseline. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases pass (added 3 new — FIX 5 invalid mealType now returns 400 with clean JSON; activity/log and activity/water no longer 500 on bad payloads). Frontend: all 4 UI fixes verified on 390px viewport — WeeklyCalendar shows all 7 days Sun-Sat with no horizontal overflow, Dashboard Weight card renders a centered Scale icon in a soft circular badge consistent with the other 3 metric cards, Profile avatar loads clean unsplash portrait, both Go-Premium link and Upgrade-Now button open SubscriptionPaywallModal (paywall-modal), all 3 activity tiles are now <button> and open ActivityInsightModal.

minor.issue: Controllers coerce/default invalid inputs (Number(x ?? default), req.body spread) so bad payloads return 200/201 instead of 400. Not a regression — handleControllerError is wired but never triggered because Mongoose never sees invalid data. Behavioral only; no 500s observed.

issues: React Router v6 future flag warnings still logged (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) — cosmetic, carried over from iter 1

action_items: (Optional) Tighten activity controller input validation (reject non-numeric amountMl / duration explicitly) so handleControllerError can return 400 on bad data too.
(Optional, carried over) Opt into React Router v7 future flags to silence console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: handleControllerError util is clean and correctly maps mongoose ValidationError/CastError → 400; good shared helper.
Activity controllers still rely on defensive coercion (Number(x ?? default)) which masks bad input — consider Pydantic-style guard before hitting the model.
Profile paywall state was correctly lifted into UserProfile.tsx and both entry points wire to the same modal instance — no duplication.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 5 targeted fixes + light regression

seed_data_creation: None new. Used existing seed (Grace, avatar re-seeded to photo-1534528741775-53994a69daeb, today's meals). Tests write TEST_-prefixed nutrition logs and toggle weight/water which persist harmlessly.
